entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix Scorecard Test showing no data for South End and Rose Creek
entries.summary: Studios with empty week_1_start in pre-weeks config now show their scorecard weeks instead of being incorrectly treated as pre-launch.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix broken image thumbnails in Meta Ads table
entries.summary: Reverts using the Drive /view URL as — it is a viewer page, not an image. Image ads now display their permanent facebook.com/ads/image URL as before.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: GBP reviews table now breaks out 1-4 star counts
entries.summary: The Google Business Profile "By Studio" table now shows separate columns for 1-star through 4-star review counts, alongside the existing 5-star column.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Redesigned the Meta Ads Spend (Corporate Account) report to fetch monthly instead of daily
entries.summary: This report now fetches corporate-account Meta spend once a month, right after each month closes, instead of tracking individual ads daily with a rolling re-fetch window. Filters now select whole months only (defaulting to last month) instead of arbitrary date ranges.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix video ad thumbnails showing as blue play button in NSO dashboard
entries.summary: NSO script now re-fetches video thumbnail URLs when their Facebook CDN expiry (oe= param) is within 2 days, so poster frames stay visible. Image ad URLs are still cached as before.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix video ad thumbnails showing as blue play button
entries.summary: Video poster-frame thumbnails are now uploaded to Google Drive (permanent URL) so they no longer expire in ~24 hours. Fixes the blue play-button fallback appearing for all video-type Meta ads in both dashboards.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: NSO Scorecard: fix Est. ROMS showing 0 in W0
entries.summary: ROMS now uses the same computed cumulative marketing spend as the Total Mktg Spend row, so W0 no longer shows 0 when Snowflake has no stored cumTs value.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: NSO W0 RMR Breakdown now includes pre-launch presales
entries.summary: The W0 column in the RMR Breakdown table now correctly shows the total member count including all pre-launch presales, not just the W0-week-only count from Snowflake. Previously the fix only applied when Snowflake had tier_rmr_by_week data for W0; it now applies regardless of which data source provides the initial count.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: The Leadteam Fee and a new External Agency category now reflect real Leadteam Discounts and agency costs
entries.summary: On the Summary and Blended CPR tabs, the Leadteam Fee automatically nets out any active discount for a studio, and a new External Agency spend category shows up alongside Google/Meta/Leadteam Ads for studios using an outside marketing agency.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: NSO scorecard CPL fix — digital leads only, spend from sub-rows
entries.summary: Blended CPL now divides by digital-only leads (not digital + grassroots), matching the CPR tab. Leadteam fee uses the same formula in all tabs. Total Mktg Spend is computed as the explicit sum of its sub-rows so the displayed total and the CPL/CPA ratio always use the same number.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: GBP review counts now update with the date filter
entries.summary: The Avg Star Rating, Total Reviews, and 5-Star Reviews cards on the Google Business Profile tab now reflect the selected date range instead of always showing an all-time total.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: NSO pre-launch week data in Scorecard Test + W0 chart fixes
entries.summary: Pre-week columns in the Scorecard Test now show presales, CPL, CPA, and RMR Breakdown data (T1 members, total members, Est. RMR, Est. ROMS). W0 cumulative and weekly charts fixed for studios where Snowflake W0 is a catch-all row that already includes pre-week totals.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Website tab now shows a sitewide traffic trend
entries.summary: Added a new chart on the Website tab showing total site sessions over time (daily/weekly/monthly), separate from the per-studio breakdown and unaffected by the studio filter.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Glossary tab is now available to everyone
entries.summary: The metric definitions glossary, previously admin-only and marked Alpha, is now visible to all dashboard users.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: NSO timeline marker stagger + campaign 2-weeks daily refresh
entries.summary: Timeline markers that overlap now stagger above and below the bar instead of overlapping. Added daily CI refresh for the 2 Weeks for $40 campaign dashboard, scheduled at 6:30 AM ET (later than all other dashboards).

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix pre-launch chart and presales display for Summary Test tab
entries.summary: Pre-launch studios (e.g. Long Beach) now show correct presales, leads, and chart data even before Week 0 is configured. Chart filters future weeks, uses date-range labels, and no longer spikes at Week 0 or extends to W28.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: NSO pre-launch scorecard test tabs + daily CI sync fix
entries.summary: Improved pre-launch scorecard test tabs (date-range columns, no RMR Breakdown, fixed timeline labels), added community events from new Google Sheet, and fixed the daily workflow so test-tab data refreshes every day alongside the normal tabs.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: NSO pre-launch studios with Goal to Announce now show recent sales activity
entries.summary: When a studio has a Goal to Announce Opening set but hasn't entered Week 0 yet, the Summary tab now shows Last 7 Full Days and Total to Date sections with actual lead and presale counts — without goal bars or pace markers — so teams can track early sales activity before launch.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Remove Offsite Conversions card from Meta Ads tab
entries.summary: The Offsite Conversions (Alpha) metric is hidden from the Meta Ads tab in both OS and NSO dashboards. Data is still being collected and can be re-enabled with a one-line change.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Reston and Naples - Mercato now show in Open Studio dashboard as open studios
entries.summary: Both studios have officially opened. Removed them from the default exclusion list so they appear in the OS dashboard alongside other open studios.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Enable Instagram data for Charlotte South End, Long Beach, and OKC Rose Creek
entries.summary: Added Facebook page IDs for 3 studios that were being skipped in the daily Instagram fetch. They will now appear in social insights data.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix GBP fetch to respect --days window instead of always re-fetching from 2025-01-01
entries.summary: The --days flag was being ignored; every daily run re-fetched the full GBP history back to Jan 2025. Now --days 30 correctly limits each run to the last 30 days while historical data is preserved via merge.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Added a monthly job that re-checks the last 90 days of Meta ad spend attribution
entries.summary: Daily refreshes only re-verify the last ~week of ad-to-studio attribution, so a mismatch like the Reston/Prestonwood one could sit undetected once it aged past that window. A new monthly job re-fetches the last 90 days so misattributed ads and their spend self-correct automatically, without needing another manual audit.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Meta creative fetch skips gracefully when API rate limit persists
entries.summary: If the Meta Ads Management rate limit (error 80004) is still active after one 90-second retry, the creative batch is skipped and the refresh continues instead of blocking for several minutes.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Reduce refresh lookback windows to speed up daily runs
entries.summary: Instagram fetch cut from ~23 min to ~2-4 min by reducing lookback from 90 to 5 days and doubling parallel workers. GBP now merges into existing history instead of re-fetching everything from 2025. Meta Ads lookback reduced to 8 days for both dashboards.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Austin - Zilker is now categorized as a closed studio
entries.summary: The studio filter on the Open Studio Dashboard now lists Austin - Zilker under "Closed" instead of "Open Studios", and it's unchecked by default.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Fixed a Meta ad spend double-counting bug in the paid ads dashboards
entries.summary: paid-ads-dashboards had its own independent copy of the same double-counting bug just fixed in the main data pipeline. An ad that got re-matched to a different studio between runs could have its spend counted twice. Now fixed there too, and both pipelines share the same data-quality alert feed.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Added a data-quality alert banner to the dashboards home screen
entries.summary: Admin users now see a red banner on the home screen whenever a Meta ad's studio attribution unexpectedly changed between data refreshes, instead of a discrepancy sitting undetected until someone manually compares a number against the real ad account.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Fixed a bug where an ad's spend could be counted twice if it got reattributed to a different studio
entries.summary: A small number of ads were being counted under two different studios at once for the same days, inflating both studios' totals (and the company-wide total). Found via a ~$110 July discrepancy on Reston's numbers versus the real ad account.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: NSO Funnel — gráfica de Lead→Net Sale Conversion Rate
entries.summary: Agrega KPI card y gráfica de Lead→Net Sale conversion rate al tab de Funnel del NSO dashboard, con toggle y granularidad Daily/Weekly/Monthly.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Fixed the Meta Ads Spend (Corporate Account) report to correctly handle studios that moved to their own ad account
entries.summary: The report was dropping a studio's entire spend history if it later moved to its own dedicated Meta ad account, even for months before the move. It now shows the real corporate-account spend up to each studio's migration date and nets to $0 automatically afterward, with no manual configuration needed.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Blended CPR tab — lead fix, net sales, new cost sources (Grassroots, Print, PR, External Agency, Other)
entries.summary: Fixed lead double-counting and gross-vs-net sales in Blended CPR. Added 5 new cost source toggles (Grassroots, Print/Signs, PR, External Agency, Other Marketing Spend) sourced from a Google Sheet. CPR chart now shows lines only with no bottom legend. Monthly fees pro-rated by actual calendar days.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Refresh 2 Weeks for $40 campaign data through Aug 30
entries.summary: Updates 2weeks_data.json with 6 days of campaign data — 70 transactions, 99 Meta leads, and $4,774 in Meta spend across 19 studios.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Fixed a duplicate report card that reappeared under Staging Reports
entries.summary: A merge from another branch accidentally brought back an old duplicate of the OS Dashboard Agency Spend card inside Staging Reports; removed it so it only appears once, on the main Admin Reports page.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Add 2 Weeks for $40 campaign tab to Campaign Dashboard
entries.summary: Integrates the summer 2026 "2 Weeks for $40" promotion as a new campaign button with dedicated Summary and Ads Report views, including adset-level Meta spend split by studio and Meta leads data from Snowflake.

entries.author: danieljimenezLT
entries.title: visual refresh on Meta Ads Dashboard
entries.summary: Visual refresh on the Meta Ads Dashboard: updated color tokens, redesigned page header, Oswald italic KPI labels, and tabs migrated to the shared nav-tab system.

entries.author: danieljimenezLT
entries.title: add 2 Weeks for $40 campaign
entries.summary: Adds the "2 Weeks for $40" Open Studios campaign (Aug 25 – Sep 7, 2026) to the Meta Ads Dashboard. Updates config, ETL output path, and dashboard data with 44 leads and $2,062 in spend through Aug 27.

entries.author: danieljimenezLT
entries.title: add Meta Ads Dashboard card to staging-reports
entries.summary: Adds the paid ads dashboard link to the staging reports index page.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: The Leadteam Discount / External Agency spend report is no longer marked as staging
entries.summary: The OS Dashboard Agency Spend admin report has been reviewed and approved — it now lives on the main Marketing Admin Reports page instead of under Staging Reports.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: NSO Dashboard — Blended CPR tab (admin-only alpha)
entries.summary: Adds a new Blended CPR tab to the NSO dashboard for admin users, showing blended cost per lead and cost per sale across Meta Ads, Google Ads, and Leadteam Fee, with OS-style spend breakdown and time-series chart.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix NSO ad media sync — cache Meta creatives to avoid rate limits, fix image download 403 errors
entries.summary: Reduced daily Meta creative API calls from ~1,500 to ~20-30 (new ads only) by caching already-known thumbnails. Fixed image download failures caused by emg1 proxy URLs and missing image hashes in sync_ad_media.py.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Added a new Staging Reports section to Marketing Admin Reports, including a preview of Leadteam Discounts and External Agency spend on the OS Dashboard
entries.summary: Admins can now see how Leadteam fee discounts and external agency costs affect marketing spend on a new staging report, and work-in-progress admin reports are now grouped under a dedicated Staging Reports section; the main OS Dashboard everyone else sees is unchanged.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix NSO video player for Google Drive and Facebook embed links
entries.summary: Videos stored in Google Drive were showing a blank player in the NSO dashboard. Fixed by using an iframe embed for Drive and Facebook URLs, matching the behavior of the Open Studio dashboard.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Add SC2 test tabs with PRE_WEEKS-aligned week dates for NSO scorecard
entries.summary: New Summary Test and Scorecard Test tabs let admins review week boundaries aligned to PRE_WEEKS Google Sheet before transitioning the main scorecard. Includes corrected date cascade for W2+, Naples date fix, and pre-launch chart fallback for newer studios.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Added a new admin report showing Meta Ads spend by studio and month
entries.summary: Marketing Admin Reports now has a Meta Ads Spend (Corporate Account) report — a studio-by-month spend table (with CSV export) covering studios billed through the shared corporate Meta ad account, for use in corporate billing.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix missing thumbnails and add post links for boosted-post ads
entries.summary: SHARE-type Meta ads (boosted organic posts like Hyrox - Video - Purpose) now show their thumbnail in the ad grid, and clicking opens the original Facebook post instead of a broken preview link.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Track grassroots leads separately in pre-Week-0 data
entries.summary: fetch_pre_weeks.py now computes grassroots_leads per pre-week bucket in nso_pre_weeks_data.json, showing how many pre-opening leads came from grassroots outreach.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix Reston early-week lead and IG data; fix Naples week 0 start date
entries.summary: Reston weeks 0–6 now show correct historical leads (from manually-compiled static file) and IG follower counts. Naples week 0 start date corrected to Feb 1, 2026.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Milestone dates now sync automatically from NSO Config Google Sheet
entries.summary: Pre-Launch Milestone dates in the Scorecard tab (MBO date, Paid Presales Start, etc.) are now read directly from the NSO Config spreadsheet on every daily refresh. Updating a date in the Sheet will appear in the dashboard automatically the next day.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Restore Pre-Launch Milestones in Scorecard tab
entries.summary: Milestone dates (Full Marketing Build Out, Paid Presales Start, etc.) were accidentally dropped from all studios in a recent rebuild. They are now restored and the build script will preserve them on every future refresh.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Restore "Goal to Announce Opening" and fix Herriman Meta spend in Scorecard
entries.summary: Scorecard now correctly shows the presale goal-to-announce threshold for all studios, and Herriman's Meta Ads spend is attributed correctly in the Scorecard tab (was $0 due to dedicated ad account not being matched by campaign name).

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Add OKC - Rose Creek to NSO Scorecard
entries.summary: Rose Creek now appears in the Scorecard tab after its Week 1 Start date was configured. Also updated studios.json with Snowflake ID and platform IDs.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Add OKC - Rose Creek and Charlotte - South End as NSO studios
entries.summary: Rose Creek and South End now appear in the NSO dashboard studio selector alongside Long Beach, with correct data.json, Meta Ads, and scorecard mappings. Also fixes South End scorecard leads showing 0 (wrong data_name lookup).

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix portrait video clipping in OS Dashboard ad lightbox
entries.summary: Vertical video ads (9:16) were being clipped at the bottom in the ad viewer modal. Normalized embed width to 360px and replaced the fixed 16:9 aspect ratio with a flexible height, so portrait videos display fully and landscape videos are letterboxed.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix Long Beach "Total to Date" leads showing 0
entries.summary: build_scorecard_from_data.py was matching data.json rows by the wrong studio name field, so Long Beach had 0 cumulative leads. Fixed to use the correct short name (data_name) and populated the scorecard with 60 leads to date.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Video ads open in an inline lightbox; daily sync fills up to 200 videos per run
entries.summary: Video ad thumbnails now open in a centered modal overlay at 640px wide instead of navigating to a full-page Facebook embed. Fixed width clipping on the embed player. Also increased the daily video sync cap to 200 per run so pending embed URLs fill faster.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Video ads now open in an inline lightbox instead of a new tab
entries.summary: Clicking a video ad thumbnail now opens the video in a centered modal overlay at 640px wide, instead of navigating to a full-page Facebook embed URL in a new tab.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Add Long Beach studio button to NSO dashboard
entries.summary: Long Beach now appears as a selectable studio in the NSO dashboard. All internal lookup maps (Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, scorecard) have been updated to recognize it.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Add Long Beach as a New Studio Opening
entries.summary: Long Beach (NY-005) is now fully configured in the studio registry with its Snowflake ID, Google Ads CID, GBP location ID, Instagram ID, and GA4 page path. It will appear in all NSO dashboard fetch scripts on next run.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix workflow crash and wrong Drive videos appearing per studio
entries.summary: Fixed a NameError in the daily fetch script and reset the OS media cache so each studio's version of a shared creative now links to the correct Drive video.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix wrong Drive videos appearing for ads with the same creative name
entries.summary: Removed studio-prefix dedup that caused all studios running the same ad creative to share a single Drive file. Each studio's version is now uploaded and linked independently.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Deduplicate Drive ad media — 90% fewer files
entries.summary: Ads sharing the same creative now reuse one Drive file (dedup by video_id, image_hash, and creative name). Image links now open in Drive viewer like videos. Reduces OS Drive files from ~2,159 to ~203.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix empty Active Ads table for admin users
entries.summary: Corrects a JavaScript scoping bug that caused the Active Ads table to render empty for admin users when the Drive image URL feature was active.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix Google Drive rate limit on ad media sync
entries.summary: Adds retry with exponential backoff and a per-run image upload cap (300) to prevent hitting Drive API limits when uploading ad images for the first time.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Ad thumbnails now open full 1080px resolution on click for all ad types
entries.summary: Carousel and Advantage+ ads previously showed ~600px images when clicked by admin users. Now all static ad types fetch and upload the full 1080×1080 image to Drive.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Admin users can now click ad thumbnails/names to open full-res images and videos from Google Drive
entries.summary: Clicking an ad in the Meta Ads table (OS and NSO dashboards) opens the full-resolution image or video on Google Drive for admin users. Non-admin behavior is unchanged.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix Refresh Meta Ads Only workflow to also sync thumbnails/videos to Drive
entries.summary: The manual "Refresh Meta Ads Data Only" workflow now runs the Drive sync step after fetching Meta data, consistent with the main daily refresh workflow.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Sync Meta ad thumbnails and videos to Google Drive for permanent display
entries.summary: Ad thumbnails and videos are now downloaded during each daily refresh and stored in Google Drive. OS ads with expiring URLs are refreshed on a 90-day rolling basis; NSO ad media is kept for the full year. This replaces HMAC-expiring CDN URLs that would go dark between refreshes.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix video/carousel ad thumbnails showing small in the ads list
entries.summary: Applied the same _p64x64 URL-strip trick used in the lightbox to the 44px list thumbnail cell, so video and carousel ads now display at full resolution in both the NSO and Open Studio dashboards.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix Open Studio ads thumbnails — more ads now show images instead of dark squares
entries.summary: Meta emg1 proxy URLs are now unwrapped to extract permanent facebook.com/ads/image/ URLs, fixing ~777 ads whose thumbnails were showing broken/dark due to expired CDN tokens.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix Naples data disappearing from NSO dashboard after studio opened
entries.summary: Naples showed 0 sales and empty client history in the NSO dashboard because changing its status to 'open' dropped it from the data fetch. Added an nso_track flag so it keeps appearing in both dashboards.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fix Naples membership count — exclude non-membership products
entries.summary: Single Class, Guest Pass, free class passes, and other Class/Class Packs were incorrectly counted as memberships in the Naples Funnel tab. Now only products with REVENUE_CATEGORY = 'Memberships' (and not presales, employee, or guest passes) are counted, reducing the inflated Total New Sales figure to the correct value.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Open Studio ad lightbox — full-res images and easier close
entries.summary: Ad lightbox in Open Studio now shows full-resolution images (matching NSO behavior) and the dark backdrop on the sides is now wider and easier to click to close the lightbox.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Naples - Mercato is now categorized as an open studio
entries.summary: The studio filter on the Open Studio Dashboard now lists Naples - Mercato under "Open Studios" instead of "NSO" (it stays unchecked by default, same as before).

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: NSO week grid now extends continuously after a studio opens
entries.summary: Fixed Naples data stopping at a fixed week ceiling after its opening date. Week buckets now auto-extend as time passes, so post-opening membership and sales data continues to appear in the dashboard.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Preview Week & Grand Opening milestones scoped to Reston only
entries.summary: The derived Preview Week and Grand Opening milestone cards now only appear for Reston. Other studios continue showing only the standard pre-launch milestone cards from the sheet.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: NSO Pre-Launch Milestones now persist across daily refreshes
entries.summary: Preview Week and Grand Opening are now auto-generated from the sheet's Target Opening Date column and no longer wiped on each daily data refresh.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Added a plain-English changelog for the admin dashboard
entries.summary: Admins can now see what's changed across the dashboards in plain English, grouped by dashboard area, updated automatically whenever a change is merged.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fixed missing history in the Brand Safety Audit tool
entries.summary: Past audit cycles had stopped showing up after a backend change. The tool now retrieves that history through a secure connection, so all past cycles are visible again.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Brand Safety Audit's date filter now searches everything
entries.summary: The post-date filter previously only checked the audit cycle currently open on screen. It now searches across every past cycle, so filtering by date returns complete results.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Added Summer Pass and 33% Off to the Campaign Dashboard
entries.summary: The Campaign Dashboard now tracks the Summer Pass promotion (May 15 – Jun 15, with post-promo tracking through Aug 15) and the 33% Off campaign, both populated with real performance numbers.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Added Reston's opening milestones to the New Studio Dashboard
entries.summary: Preview Week and Grand Opening milestones for the Reston studio launch are now tracked alongside the rest of its new-studio-opening data.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Long Beach and Rose Creek added as New Studio Openings
entries.summary: Both studios now appear in the New Studio Opening dashboard, and weekly sales figures correctly show as negative when a studio has more cancellations than new sign-ups.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Added the Leads Detail download button to the New Studio Dashboard
entries.summary: The on-demand CSV lead-list download already available on the Open Studio Dashboard is now also available in the New Studio Opening dashboard.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Added membership tier tracking for Naples
entries.summary: The New Sales tab and scorecard now break down Naples' recurring membership revenue by tier, instead of only showing one combined total.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Added an on-demand Leads Detail download button
entries.summary: You can now download a detailed CSV list of leads directly from the Open Studio Dashboard, instead of requesting one manually.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Brand Safety Audit can now filter by the post's own date
entries.summary: You can filter Instagram posts in the Brand Safety Audit tool by the date they were actually published, making it easier to review a specific week or month.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Brand Safety Audit: easier to browse past review cycles
entries.summary: Added a picker to browse and review previous Brand Safety Audit runs, and fixed a bug where publishing a new cycle could occasionally save incomplete data.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Added a totals row to the Funnel tab
entries.summary: The Funnel tab now shows a conversion-rate totals row, summarizing the full funnel at a glance instead of requiring you to work it out from each stage.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Added a Network Average comparison to the Summary tab
entries.summary: KPI cards on the Summary tab, and now the Funnel, First Timers, and Blended CPR tabs too, show how your studio compares to the network average — not just how it's trending against its own past periods.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fixed a missing goal target after a data rebuild
entries.summary: A studio's milestone/goal target could occasionally get lost whenever its scorecard data was rebuilt. It's now automatically restored every time.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fort Myers presale data now shows in the New Studio Dashboard
entries.summary: Fort Myers' pre-opening sales data is now correctly linked and visible in the New Studio Opening dashboard.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fixed how presale sign-ups get credited to their source
entries.summary: Presale sign-ups are now matched to the correct marketing source (e.g. website vs. a third-party listing), fixing a mismatch introduced by a recent data update.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Added call and direction tracking to Google Ads, opened up dashboard access
entries.summary: The New Studio Opening dashboard's Google Ads tab now shows Opportunities, Cost per Opportunity, Calls, and Direction requests. Franchisees and studio managers can also now access the Open Studio Dashboard, not just corporate and admin users.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Added a Glossary tab to the Open Studio Dashboard
entries.summary: A new admin-only Glossary tab explains what each metric on the dashboard means.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Brand Safety Audit: choose a custom date range for downloads
entries.summary: You can now pick a specific date range when downloading posts from the Brand Safety Audit tool, instead of only getting a fixed default range.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fixed Google Ads data matching for three studios
entries.summary: Google Ads performance data now correctly links to Dunwoody, Old Bridge, and Middletown, instead of being missed due to a naming mismatch.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Launched the Brand Safety Audit dashboard
entries.summary: A new admin-only tool reviews Instagram posts against SWEAT440's brand safety guidelines.

entries.author: Santiago Estrada
entries.title: Added a conversion rate trend chart to the Funnel tab
entries.summary: The Funnel tab now shows how conversion rates have trended over time, instead of only the current snapshot.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Added a full Meta Ads report to the Campaign Dashboard
entries.summary: The Campaign Dashboard now includes a full breakdown of Meta Ads performance data.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Dynamic weekly goals and lead-source filtering added
entries.summary: The Summary tab's weekly sales goal now recalculates automatically based on how many weeks remain until opening day, and Client History now lets you filter by, and see, the marketing source for each entry.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Fixed duplicate lead counting from Meta Ads
entries.summary: Some Meta Ads leads were being counted twice. That's now fixed, so Meta lead totals are accurate.

entries.author: Sebastian Arango
entries.title: Meta Ads leads now split into Native and Offsite
entries.summary: Meta Ads reporting now separates leads generated directly on Meta's platform from those tracked via offsite conversions, giving a clearer picture of where leads actually come from.
